footnotes: The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss widened to $178M from $94.3M.
The net loss widened to $166M, or −$4.32 per share, from $80.5M. Operating cash flow was −$161M and free cash flow −$161M, versus −$70.2M.
sources: ArriVent BioPharma, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
